title: Signed line OrdinaryConstraints
statement: For any module sheaf P over a commutative ring sheaf A, there exist the ordinary unit, positive-power reassociation isomorphisms and negative-positive evaluation transformations satisfying OrdinaryLineConstraints(A,P) [def-pur-signed-line-ordinary-constraint-data]. They are natural in the module tensored on the left and have exactly the unit, reassociation and contraction pure-section formulas of that definition.

source.place: Tags 03D2, 03D3, 03EL and 0FNY; for derived localization use derived.tex Tags 06YU, 07A4 and 015F. Specialization of the Powers and duals paragraph of the current blueprint.

proof.text: Construct the right unitor by scalar multiplication and the positive product by the sheaf tensor associator. Pure tensors determine their naturality. Construct evaluation as sheafification of the explicit internal-Hom pairing; reassociate and contract the last two factors, then apply the right unitor. Tensor generation proves naturality, and the sheafification adjunction gives exactly the three pure-section formulas.

proof_origin.place: Powers and duals, including unit, positive tensor recursion, evaluation, and unbounded derived action. The component proof is given below and in the attached Lean module.

lean.statement:
theorem signed_line_ordinary_constraints (P : KFlatFixedTensor.Modules A) :
  ∃ ordinaryUnit : siteSheafTensorRight (signedLinePower.{u, v, w} P 0) ≅ 𝟭 _,
  ∃ ordinaryProduct : ∀ n : ℕ,
    siteSheafTensorRight (signedLinePower.{u, v, w} P (.ofNat (n + 1))) ⋙
        siteSheafTensorRight (signedLinePower.{u, v, w} P 1) ≅
      siteSheafTensorRight (signedLinePower.{u, v, w} P (.ofNat (n + 2))),
  ∃ ordinaryEvaluation : ∀ n : ℕ,
    siteSheafTensorRight (signedLinePower.{u, v, w} P (.negSucc n)) ⋙
      siteSheafTensorRight (signedLinePower.{u, v, w} P (.ofNat (n + 1))) ⟶ 𝟭 _,
    (∀ (N : KFlatFixedTensor.Modules A) (V : Cᵒᵖ)
      (x : N.val.obj V) (r : A.obj.obj V),
      (ordinaryUnit.hom.app N).val.app V
        (siteSheafTensorTmul N (signedLinePower.{u, v, w} P 0) V x r) =
          @SMul.smul (((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj A).obj.obj V)
            (N.val.obj V) inferInstance r x) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (N : KFlatFixedTensor.Modules A) (V : Cᵒᵖ)
      (x : N.val.obj V) (y : (scalarTensorPower A P (n + 1)).val.obj V)
      (q : P.val.obj V),
      ((ordinaryProduct n).hom.app N).val.app V
        (siteSheafTensorTmul _ P V
          (siteSheafTensorTmul N (scalarTensorPower A P (n + 1)) V x y) q) =
        siteSheafTensorTmul N (scalarTensorPower A P (n + 2)) V x
          (siteSheafTensorTmul (scalarTensorPower A P (n + 1)) P V y q)) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (N : KFlatFixedTensor.Modules A) (V : Cᵒᵖ)
      (x : N.val.obj V) (φ : (signedLinePower.{u, v, w} P (.negSucc n)).val.obj V)
      (y : (scalarTensorPower A P (n + 1)).val.obj V),
      ((ordinaryEvaluation n).app N).val.app V
        (siteSheafTensorTmul _ (scalarTensorPower A P (n + 1)) V
          (siteSheafTensorTmul N (signedLinePower.{u, v, w} P (.negSucc n)) V x φ) y) =
        @SMul.smul (((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj A).obj.obj V)
          (N.val.obj V) inferInstance (φ.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 V.unop))) y) x)
